primary_unit: A fully completed fresh raw/contract server pair for each registered model and repeat.
selection: Use the chronologically first valid complete paired attempt. Preserve incomplete/failed attempts separately; never select by score, coverage or speed.
population: All 4725 future request pairs across four configurations and three repetitions; all initialization, reference and verification paths retained.
primary_per_repeat_metrics: Future requests divided by directly observed full client wall plus final backend drain, separately for raw and ContractKV.
Matched full-wall throughput multiplier: raw service wall / ContractKV service wall.
Future business mean TTFT and task-score distribution on the exact same session/turn keys.
All initialization-controller elapsed time, with qualification-started and L0-only initialization separated.
All raw-reference calls and every compact verification attempt, including exceptions; do not substitute the legacy final successful call timer.

Amortized qualification-charged future mean: ContractKV future business TTFT plus the complete qualification-started controller sum divided by all future requests. Compare to the stated raw future business reference; do not label this an observed per-request readiness or full service wall.
cost_partition: Within each sequential controller body, group raw-reference/verification call events until the matching complete_controller event. Calls are nonoverlapping. Sum all completed controller bodies for initialization; count qualification-started bodies when a raw-reference or compact verification event occurred. Report NOT_REQUIRED/L0 warm-up separately.
completeness_checks: The registered future session/turn sets agree exactly in both routes, with no missing or duplicate requests.
Every emitted canary row has exactly one positive controller duration, including rejection and exception paths.
Every observed descent attempt has its own elapsed-time event; retain calls even when the old canary result overwrites verification_ms with zero.
Cross-check verifier call events against server access records and retained returned endpoint durations; exceptions before RPC must not be counted as known completed RPC durations.
Full service wall charges logging and final drain; server startup and immutable preflight remain outside the declared clock.
Every pair/cell has immutable input, launch, timer and response digests; invalid partial pairs are not resumed or used as complete data.
quality_reporting: Report all-route task-score increases, decreases and changes within +/-0.03, using the existing scorer. Report output-text changes separately if full output IDs are unavailable. Do not infer behavioral equivalence solely from equal task scores.
aggregation: Retain all three repeat points and min/max. Report arithmetic mean of per-repeat effects and pooled-wall multiplier as separately named estimands. No new narrow CI from treating related turns as independent.
historical_comparison: Display alongside the legacy residual-RPC accounting without overwriting it. Fresh timer measurements never become recovered July timestamps. Do not combine this original-cohort protocol with the faithful non-RULER main cohort as one causal curve.
stopping_rule: Complete exactly the frozen matrix unless an actual infrastructure/protocol failure prevents execution. Do not add sources or tune parameters to improve an observed outcome.
